column7: POST /auth/refresh: the session lookup fault (pre-verdict, slot handed back) and the owner GetUser fault (post-verdict, slot kept) answered 401 like a dead token, so a client dropped a live session during an outage; both now answer 503 + Retry-After storage_unavailable (TestRefresh_GetUserFaultKeepsSlotAndIs503, TestRefresh_PreVerdictFaultLeavesTokenUsable). POST /auth/webauthn/login/finish: an identity-read fault after the assertion verified answers 503 with the lockout cost of a failed assertion and no session (TestFinishWebAuthnLogin_CompleteLoginFaultIs503AndCostsLikeAFailedAssertion). Post-verdict write faults keep the 401. Andrei decision on ask auth-endpoint-outage-1-refresh-webauthn-postverdict-503: 503 for both (a refresh token and an assertion cannot be guessed).
